name: feature-focused-tester-plugin
description: Plugin for planning, writing, and executing tests targeted at a modified feature via a 3-layer flow that mirrors the data boundary: Layer 1 Test UI (render/states/responsive), Layer 2 Test call API (data hooks -> repositories -> adapters, query keys + mutation invalidation), Layer 3 Test flow (E2E). Produces test_plan.md / walkthrough.md and reports QA to Telegram Thread 735.
